title: Lesson 36 - Testing the Security Model: Validation, Sharing Graphs, Test Matrix, Audit
description: Given a set of conditions, determine how to test the sharing model.

questions.question: What is the most reliable way to verify a sharing model before rollout?
options: Log in as representative users from each access class and assert their view/edit per record via a test matrix
Only test as the system admin
questions.explanation: A per-user-class test matrix with runAs/login-as assertions verifies both granted and denied access. Testing as admin alone or trusting summaries misses per-class bugs.

questions.question: How can an architect validate the COMPOSITION of a record's effective sharing?
options: Open the record's Sharing detail to see the share-graph rows and their sources (OWD, hierarchy, rules, teams, Apex)
questions.explanation: The Sharing detail lists the share rows and their RowCause/source, revealing exactly which mechanism grants access - essential to catch unexpected grants. Folders, profiles, and backups do not show this.

questions.question: Why must recalculation paths be part of security testing?
options: Criteria changes, ownership transfers, and rule edits can leave stale or missing grants that only recalculation testing surfaces
Recalc is automatic and always correct
questions.explanation: Testing recalculation catches stale (or missing) share rows after the conditions rules depend on change. Recalc is not cosmetic or always-correct - it must be exercised and validated.
